description: Block by Block On-Street Paid Parking is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. Dataset represents parking allocations and restrictions by block-faces using pay-by-phone (as an alternative to parking by paystations). Coverage: Winnipeg. The portal files it under the category Parking. Its tags are on-street, parking, blockface, pay by phone, payment. The table has 17 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
